questions.prompt: Ask a partner about the familiar trip. After their reply, request one clarification and suggest a practical next step.
questions.context:
You are arranging a meeting. The partner says they have visited Beijing before, but you miss whether they want to meet today or tomorrow. Ask about their experience, request repetition of the missed meeting time, then propose meeting after that time is clarified. Do not invent their answer.
Familiar meanings available: to meet; to see each other; before; formerly; please say it once more.
questions.label: Take your speaking turn

rubric.text: My follow-up depends on the partner’s reply.
I asked for clarification before assuming the missing fact.

questions.prompt: Write a brief update about the familiar trip for someone who was absent. Preserve who went and whether the event occurred.
questions.context:
A friend was absent from a travel conversation. You have travelled before; the other person has not. No destination or date was given. Write an update preserving whose experience is positive and whose is negative.
Familiar meanings available: before; formerly; travel; go on a trip; not; have not.
questions.label: Write your own message

rubric.text: My account preserves participants and event status.
Its sequence or reason is clear without an unexplained jump.
